clue.text: Nick, Matthew or Herbert in Dickens

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to nick is to steal
second meaning: Matthew ... and his son Herbert are characters in Great Expectations

explanation.surface: A roll-call of three men, apparently all named in Dickens.
explanation.walkthrough: Nick reads as a third first name beside Matthew and Herbert, but it is a verb meaning steal.
explanation.definitionFit: To pocket something is to take it dishonestly, and Pocket is the surname of Matthew and Herbert in Great Expectations.

clue.text: Calling for fines, so furious

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for

indicators.note: furious suggests wild disorder, so these letters are thrown into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone is enraged at being summoned to pay penalties.
explanation.definitionFit: A calling is one's vocation or occupation, the same idea as a profession.

clue.text: Deeply distressed, share being over?

parts.note: a cut is a share, as in a cut of the profits
up means over or finished, as in time's up

explanation.surface: Someone is devastated that their portion has come to an end.
explanation.definitionFit: Being cut up is informal British usage for being very upset or grief-stricken.

clue.text: For example, copper kettle has one

definitions.meaning: first meaning: copper is an example of a chemical ...
second meaning: an electric kettle has a heating ...

explanation.surface: A copper kettle, the old-fashioned kind, is said to contain something.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pairs copper with kettle as one object; the two halves are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: Copper is a chemical element, and the heating coil in a kettle is also called an element.

clue.text: Minister, one having arrived at pulpit, initially?

indicators.note: at places the pulpit letter at the head of the word for one who arrives
initially picks out just the opening letter of the word pulpit

parts.note: a reacher is, playfully, one who has reached a place

explanation.surface: A clergyman who has just got to the pulpit.
explanation.walkthrough: REACHER is an invented word for one who reaches, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A minister of religion delivers sermons, so he is a preacher.

clue.text: Set day between sun and moon

indicators.note: between puts the day letter in the gap separating the sun and the moon

parts.note: Ra is the Egyptian sun god
Io is one of the moons of Jupiter

explanation.surface: A date is fixed for an astronomical event between sun and moon.
explanation.definitionFit: A set is a receiving apparatus, so a wireless set is a radio.

clue.text: Clear salt on crack

parts.note: an old salt is a sailor, abbreviated AB for able seaman
to crack a puzzle is to solve it

explanation.surface: Instructions to put salt on a crack, as if de-icing a path.
explanation.definitionFit: To absolve someone is to clear them of blame or guilt.

clue.text: My vicar's cigar?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: my as an exclamation of surprise
second meaning: a vicar's cigar would be holy, and its fumes smoke

explanation.walkthrough: My looks like a possessive; it is an exclamation of surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: Both 'My!' and this phrase are exclamations of astonishment, and a clergyman's cigar smoke would jokingly be sacred.

clue.text: Course went on, reportedly?

indicators.note: reportedly means as it is spoken, so the word is the one that sounds alike

parts.note: rode means travelled on, as on a horse or bus

explanation.surface: Asking whether a golf or race course carried on, as people say.
explanation.definitionFit: A road is a route or way, the course one travels along.

clue.text: Experience heavy blow, as would Oscars attendee?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to be dazed after a hit on the head
second meaning: someone at the Academy Awards would see film stars

explanation.walkthrough: The second half is whimsical: a guest at the Oscars ceremony sees celebrities.
explanation.definitionFit: A knock on the head makes you see flashing lights, the idiom for being stunned; celebrities are stars.

clue.text: Improving where further progress seemingly impossible, minutes saved

indicators.note: saved means kept inside, so the minutes letter is held within the phrase

parts.note: something on the end, at the very tip, can go no further

explanation.surface: Someone stuck at a dead end is told a few minutes have been rescued.
explanation.definitionFit: A patient getting better is said to be recovering, the idiom used for improving health.

clue.text: Dance: fifty entertained by it, repeatedly

indicators.note: entertained by means received as a guest within, so fifty sits inside
repeatedly says the word for it occurs a second time, side by side

parts.note: it means sex appeal, abbreviated SA
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A dancer delights in some partner over and over.
explanation.definitionFit: Salsa is a lively Latin American dance style.

clue.text: Blank — unlike 21 across?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: showing no feeling on the face
second meaning: action painting belongs to Abstract Expressionism, so something unlike it lacks expressionism

explanation.walkthrough: Action painting is a branch of Abstract Expressionism, so something unlike it is read as having no expressionism.
explanation.definitionFit: A blank look is a vacant face with no emotion shown.

clue.text: Sodden and dishevelled, get pulled round back of hovel

indicators.note: round means surrounding, so the pulled phrase wraps the hovel letter

parts.note: be dragged means to get pulled along

indicators.note: back of picks the final letter of the word hovel

explanation.surface: A wretched figure, soaked and untidy, is hauled around behind a shack.
explanation.definitionFit: Bedraggled means wet, dirty and untidy, as if trailed through mud.

clue.text: Blot on the landscape, one visited by tourist?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: an ugly thing
second meaning: a tourist attraction

explanation.walkthrough: One word covers both an eyesore and an attraction worth seeing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that looks a fright is a sight, and tourists go sightseeing.

clue.text: Drive home, smashing gate on bridge

indicators.note: smashing breaks the word up, so its letters are reshuffled

parts.note: to bridge a gap is to cross it

explanation.surface: A motorist crashes through a gate on a bridge on the way home.
explanation.definitionFit: To drive a point home is to make it understood, which is what communicating it clearly means.

clue.text: Kneel on ground clasping back of limb, behind a lower body part

indicators.note: behind places the rest after the article
clasping means holding, so the limb letter sits inside the rearranged letters
ground means crushed, so the letters are rearranged
back of picks the final letter of limb

explanation.surface: Instructions to kneel on the ground while gripping a leg.
explanation.definitionFit: The talus or ankle bone sits low in the leg, joining it to the foot.

clue.text: Dark ultimately — terribly early start — to get to US island

indicators.note: ultimately picks the final letter of Dark
terribly signals the letters are badly jumbled

parts.note: go means a start, as in from the word go

explanation.surface: An early start in the dark to reach an American island.
explanation.walkthrough: Key Largo is in the Florida Keys.
explanation.definitionFit: Key Largo is the largest of the Florida Keys, an island off the American mainland.

clue.text: Picture physician after shaving cat

indicators.note: shaving trims the ends off, so the physician word loses its first and last letters

parts.note: a doctor is a physician
pussy is an informal word for a cat

explanation.surface: A painting of a doctor whose cat has been clipped.
explanation.walkthrough: Picture means a film here: Octopussy is a James Bond movie.
explanation.definitionFit: Octopussy (1983) is a James Bond film, and a picture is a movie.

clue.text: Needle for example for canine?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the needle on a dial is an indicator
second meaning: a gun dog breed that stands still to indicate game

explanation.walkthrough: Canine suggests a tooth, but it is a dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A dial's needle indicates a reading, and the gun dog breed is named for how it indicates game.

clue.text: Rank rising sharply?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: rank as an adjective, meaning utter or absolute
second meaning: steep or perpendicular, as a cliff

explanation.walkthrough: Rank looks like a noun for position; it is the adjective meaning utter, as in rank stupidity.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheer folly is utter folly, and a sheer cliff is almost vertical.

clue.text: Constituency or housing association's ultimate politician

indicators.note: housing means containing, so the seat holds that letter

parts.note: a parliamentary seat is a constituency

indicators.note: ultimate picks the final letter of the word association

parts.note: the word association, its possessive ending set aside

explanation.surface: A legislator chosen by a district or by a housing association.
explanation.definitionFit: A senator is a member of a senate, an elected legislator.

clue.text: Excited on anticipating a style of art

indicators.note: excited means agitated, so the letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is thrilled at looking forward to an artistic style.
explanation.definitionFit: Action painting, Jackson Pollock's dripped technique, is a movement within abstract art.

clue.text: Relative bringing Ghanaian diplomat up

indicators.note: up in a down entry means read from bottom to top

parts.note: Kofi Annan, the Ghanaian who was UN Secretary-General

explanation.surface: A family member brings a West African envoy to visit.
explanation.walkthrough: The name happens to read the same both ways, so the turnaround changes nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Nanna is an affectionate word for a grandmother, a family relation.

clue.text: Having wiped brow, criminal hot under the collar

indicators.note: the brow is the top, so wiping it removes the first letter of the criminal in this down entry

parts.note: a pirate is a criminal at sea

explanation.surface: A sweaty crook mops his forehead, flustered and angry.
explanation.definitionFit: Being hot under the collar is the idiom for being angry or annoyed.

clue.text: Only half the characters, little matter

definitions.meaning: first meaning: A to M covers the first half of the alphabet's letters
second meaning: a tiny particle of matter

explanation.walkthrough: Read as A TO M, the first thirteen letters of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: An atom is the smallest unit of a chemical element, a minute piece of matter.

clue.text: Fish seller hooking customer, finally

indicators.note: hooking means catching and holding, so that letter goes inside

parts.note: a tout is a seller, as of tickets

indicators.note: finally picks the final letter of customer

explanation.surface: A fishmonger lands a buyer at last.
explanation.definitionFit: The trout is a freshwater game fish.

clue.text: First of Franciscans approaching giant screens, when vespers observed?

parts.note: nigh means near, approaching

indicators.note: screens means hides inside, so the giant word holds that letter

parts.note: giant means tall

indicators.note: First of picks the opening letter of Franciscans

explanation.surface: Friars draw near a giant who hides the first of them.
explanation.walkthrough: Vespers is the evening service in the monastic day, hence the Franciscan theme.
explanation.definitionFit: Vespers is the evening prayer, said around dusk, the onset of darkness.

clue.text: One overwhelmed by blow where justice doesn't prevail

indicators.note: overwhelmed by means engulfed, so one sits inside the wind

parts.note: the mistral is a strong wind that blows in southern France
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone bowled over by a punch where fairness fails.
explanation.definitionFit: A mistrial is a trial declared invalid, so no just verdict is reached.

clue.text: Intimate last few hours of working week?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: an intimate is a close companion

definitions.text: last few hours of working week
definitions.meaning: second meaning, read cryptically

explanation.walkthrough: Intimate looks like an adjective or verb; it is a noun for a close companion. Split the answer as FRI END.
explanation.definitionFit: An intimate is a close companion or confidant.
